019package org.apache.wiki.pages.haddock;
020
021import com.codeborne.selenide.Condition;
022import com.codeborne.selenide.Selenide;
023import com.codeborne.selenide.SelenideElement;
024import org.apache.wiki.pages.Page;
025import org.openqa.selenium.By;
026
027import java.time.Duration;
028
029/**
030 * Actions available on the Edit page.
031 */
032public class EditWikiPage implements HaddockPage {
033
034    private static final String EDIT_TEXTAREA = "textarea.editor.form-control.snipeable";
035
036    /**
037     * Open a given page for edition.
038     *
039     * @param pageName Wiki page name to Edit.
040     * @return {@link EditWikiPage} instance, to allow chaining of actions.
041     */
042    public static EditWikiPage open( final String pageName ) {
043        return Page.withUrl( Page.baseUrl() + "/Edit.jsp?page=" + pageName ).openAs( new EditWikiPage() );
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Press the cancel button and disacrd page Edit.
048     *
049     * @return {@link ViewWikiPage} instance, to allow chaining of actions.
050     */
051    public ViewWikiPage cancel() {
052        Selenide.$( By.name( "cancel" ) ).click();
053        return new ViewWikiPage();
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * Edits the page with the given text. Ensures edition is complete by ensuring the preview pane shows the edited text.
058     *
059     * @param text text to edit.
060     * @return {@link ViewWikiPage} instance, to allow chaining of actions.
061     */
062    public ViewWikiPage saveText(final String text ) {
063        return saveText( text, text );
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * Edits the page with the given text. Ensures edition is complete by ensuring the preview pane shows the preview text.
068     *
069     * @param text text text to edit.
070     * @param preview expected text to hsow up on the preview pane (i.e., page directives on edit pane shouldn't show up here).
071     * @return {@link ViewWikiPage} instance, to allow chaining of actions.
072     */
073    public ViewWikiPage saveText(final String text, final String preview ) {
074        final SelenideElement editor = Selenide.$( By.cssSelector( EDIT_TEXTAREA ) );
075        editor.clear();
076        // the editor script binds shortly after load, and it refreshes the preview on input events, which setting the value does not fire
077        for( int i = 0; i < 20; i++ ) {
078            editor.val( text );
079            Selenide.executeJavaScript( "arguments[0].dispatchEvent( new Event( 'input', { bubbles: true } ) );", editor );
080            Selenide.sleep( 500L );
081            if( !Selenide.$( By.className( "ajaxpreview" ) ).has( Condition.cssClass( "empty" ) ) ) {
082                break;
083            }
084        }
085        Selenide.$( By.className( "ajaxpreview" ) ).shouldBe( Condition.text( preview ), Duration.ofSeconds( 10L ) );
086        Selenide.$( By.name( "ok" ) ).click();
087        Selenide.$( By.cssSelector( EDIT_TEXTAREA ) ).should( Condition.disappear, Duration.ofSeconds( 10L ) );
088        return new ViewWikiPage();
089    }
090
091}
